Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util

Class BucketState

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util.BucketState
public final class BucketState extends Object
The sole reader and writer of every bucket family's persistent state, kept in the stack's NBT. Mutators edit the supplied stack in place, preserve unrelated root NBT, canonicalize empty state, and enforce the invariants that relate state to the item holding it: content kinds are exclusive, each payload sits on an item that can hold it, and amounts fit that item's capacity.

When a stack is loaded from saved NBT, admitLoadedTag(net.minecraft.world.item.Item, net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag) sets aside Junk and Trash Bucket entries that no longer load (for example, items from a removed mod), restores set-aside entries that load again while the bucket has room, and logs and removes malformed state.

    • drainFiniteContent

      public static int drainFiniteContent(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, int requestedAmount)
      Removes up to requestedAmount millibuckets from fluid or milk mode.

      Other modes and nonpositive requests return zero without mutation. Removing the final amount clears the mode-based payload while preserving unrelated and stored-item NBT.

      Returns:
      the amount actually removed, in millibuckets

    • admitLoadedTag

      public static void admitLoadedTag(net.minecraft.world.item.Item item, net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag tag)
      Admits the NBT of a item stack as it is loaded from saved data. Junk entries that do not load move to JUNK_SET_ASIDE, logged once as they move; set-aside entries that load again return, oldest first, while the bucket has room; entries beyond capacity are set aside rather than lost. Malformed mode-based state is logged with its full payload and removed. Unresolved fluid and entity ids are left in place, so removing another mod does not destroy them. Mutates tag in place.
